statement: Benchmark comparison: no directly matching work was found in the searched literature. No retrieved paper constructs a time-stamped query set over amended statutes or regulations whose successive clause versions are near-duplicates and whose gold label is a specific clause version. Adjacent resources differ on corpus, granularity or task: temporal legal MCQA with authoritative context (LEGAL-LINK-EU), point-in-time financial QA over filings (TempFinRAG, judged from its abstract only), a trilingual ESG-disclosure temporal benchmark (abstract only), a regulatory-financial sparse/dense/hybrid retrieval benchmark with no temporal dimension (abstract only), a legal RAG that filters by temporal validity and lifecycle status without a reported benchmark, and a linked-data versioning benchmark measuring storage/query performance. The benchmark contribution therefore survives only if it is positioned as version-level retrieval evaluation with recency-decoupled strata, not as 'a temporal benchmark for legal text', which already exists in multiple forms.

evidence.quote: most are focused on static question answering and do not address the temporal dynamics of legal knowledge
